title: Recurrence plot and change quantile-based deep supervised and semi-supervised protection for transmission lines connected to photovoltaic plants
core_idea: Propose a single-ended intelligent protection method for the transmission line segment between the grid and a photovoltaic plant that uses recurrence matrices and an InceptionTime-based deep learning system to detect faults via the mean change in quantiles of three-phase currents, determine fault position and faulty phase, apply ReliefF for optimal quantile feature selection, and incorporate semi-supervised paradigms (label spreading, label propagation, self-training) to mitigate label scarcity.
tldr: A machine-learning protection scheme that leverages recurrence plots, change-in-quantile features, InceptionTime, and semi-supervised methods to detect and locate faults and identify faulty phases on transmission lines connected to PV plants under varied abnormal operating conditions.
